title: Andrés Gómez Emilsson's DMT accounts at the Psychedelic Science conference

tellings.quote: I was speaking just a few days ago in Denver at psychedelic science conference with um Andres Gomez Emilson.

plain: At a psychedelic science conference in Denver in 2025, the consciousness researcher Andrés Gómez Emilsson shared his accounts of DMT, a powerful drug that many users say opens a realm of other beings. The neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore tells Michels he spoke with Emilsson there just days before, bringing it up as one more report of what people meet on the drug.
